title: McCarthy's arrival at the Sorpe
basis: The log's own time, as the blog later reads it too. Ten approaches from about 00:32, once across from the Möhne side, to the 00:46 release take 90 s each, which the blog also works out ("not much more than 90 seconds") and a tight circuit allows.

records.says: Flying as fast as he could, McCarthy made up 13 or 14 minutes by the time he reached the Sorpe at 0015
Target Z
records.label: Navigator's log, page 3

records.says: He recorded the time of arrival at Target Z as 0030
records.label: Foster on MacLean's log

title: McCarthy's route to the Sorpe
reading: The northern route by Doesburg to Rees, then the lakes, Ahlen and the Möhne
basis: The log's own legs. Rees, where it joins the southern route, lies near Wesel; Target X, the Möhne, is where it turns for the Sorpe, placed 2 km short of the dam.

records.says: Stavoren a/c Harderwijk; Harderwijk a/c Doesburg; Doesburg a/c Rees; Rees a/c Lake; Lake a/c Ahlen; Ahlen a/c Target X; Target X a/c Target Z
records.label: Navigator's log, page 3, its legs in order

records.says: Formation No. 2 flew further north, cutting over Vlieland and crossing the IJsselmeer
before joining the first route near Wesel

title: McCarthy's route home
reading: The outbound legs reversed, off course over Hamm between Ahlen and the lakes
basis: The log reverses its outbound legs and names no Hamm; its Ahlen to Rees leg, 00:59 to 01:32, takes half as long again as the same leg out, room for the deviation both blog posts describe. Times are the log's legible ones. The log crosses the English coast at Mablethorpe about 03:02 and is over base at 03:18; the replay, with no circuit of Scampton before the 03:23 landing (ORB), crosses about 03:11.

records.says: Target Z a/c Target X; Target X a/c Ahlen; Ahlen a/c Lake; Lake a/c Rees; Rees a/c Doesburg; Doesburg a/c Harderwijk; Harderwijk a/c Stavoren; Wall; Island Vlieland; Mablethorpe
records.label: Navigator's log, page 3, its legs in order

records.says: they simply backtracked along their outbound course
McCarthy set course for home, but went via the Möhne, having heard over the radio that it had been breached.
ending up over the heavily defended town of Hamm.
records.label: Foster on MacLean

title: McCarthy's runs at the Sorpe
reading: Nine dummy runs, release on the tenth
basis: Two accounts agree on ten approaches; Gibson was not at the Sorpe.

records.says: on the tenth approach, he managed to make a near perfect run, getting down to about 30 feet
McCarthy made nine attempted bombing runs before Johnson was satisfied
They had both made twelve dummy runs and had dropped their mines along the lip of the concrete

title: McCarthy's late take-off
basis: The ORB's own UP time.

records.says: Had trouble with his compass and took off 20 mins. late.
took off in the reserve aircraft 34 minutes late
AJ-T eventually took to the air some 33 minutes later than their scheduled departure time

title: Hopgood's attack
basis: No source times the release. It follows Gibson's 00:28 by B.976's three minutes for the water and leaves about a minute for the burning climb to Ostönnen.

records.says: Was seen to be hit by flak on the run-up and to have an engine on fire. He overshot with his mine
crashed near the dam power house and exploded at 0034hrs
records.label: ORB editor's note, across a page break after "power"

records.says: Der deutschen Flak auf den Türmen gelang es immerhin, einen der Bomber auf dem Zielanflug über dem Möhnesee abzuschießen

title: Young's attack
basis: No source read times it; it falls between Martin's 00:38 and Maltby's 00:49 at B.976's spacing, and secondary accounts give 00:43.

records.says: Was seen to make an accurate attack with his mine

title: Maltby's attack
basis: The ORB's 0139 repeats Shannon's Eder time on the next sheet; the breach was signalled at 00:56 and Maltby landed at 03:11.

records.says: MOHNE DAM. 1 Mine. 60ft. 0139 hrs.
Gibson told Maltby to go ahead at 0048.
at 0050 wireless operator Antony Stone radioed ‘Goner 78A’ back to Grantham.
Erst beim sechsten Anflug gelang es einer Lancaster um 00.49 Uhr, die Staumauer zu zerstören.
Die Bombe explodierte um 0:49 Uhr in der Mitte der Mauer und riss die Staumauer auf etwa 30 m Breite auf.

title: Maudslay's attack
basis: Keeps the ORB's order, after Shannon's 01:39 and before Knight's mine (about 01:52, eder-breach), with B.976's three minutes either side; "some twenty minutes" before 01:57 would put it at about 01:37, before Shannon's.

records.says: Diverted from the Mohne to the Eder Dam, attacked first and registered a direct hit, but no result was seen.
records.label: Shannon

records.says: The mine overshot and struck the parapet, detonating instantaneously.
records.label: Maudslay

records.says: Was the third aircraft to attack the Eder Dam.
records.label: Knight

records.says: At 0157, some twenty minutes after they had dropped their mine, wireless operator Alden Cottam sent a ‘Goner 28B’ message back to base

title: Eder breach
basis: On Knight's attack, two minutes before the signal; LWL's 01:37 comes before Shannon's 01:39 release in the ORB.

records.says: Etwa eine Stunde später, um 01.37 Uhr, wurde auch dieser Staudamm zerstört.
Am 17. Mai 1943 kurz vor 2 Uhr nachts wurde die Ederstaumauer bei einem Angriff
At 01:54, Hutchinson signalled the breach and then confirmed it.
The final bomb of the formation, from Knight's aircraft (N for Nut), breached the dam.

title: Burpee's loss
basis: The ORB editor's note; the two differ by seven minutes.

records.says: Shot down at 0200 immediately south of Gilze-Rijen (Netherlands) on way to target.
records.label: ORB editor's note

title: Ottley's loss
basis: Brown's sighting, the one direct observation.

records.says: At 0231, Group sent the code word “Gilbert” to AJ-C, and the signal was acknowledged.
The second signal was not acknowledged, indicating that AJ-C had met its fate at about 0231.
Ken Brown, flying AJ-F a few minutes behind, reported seeing him hit the ground at 0235.

title: The Eder flood down the valley
basis: Wabern's arrival is the one time found below the dam; the front runs there from the breach at an even pace through Affoldern, Bergheim, Wega and Fritzlar.

records.says: In der Folge ergoss sich eine 6 bis 8 m hohe Flutwelle durch das untere Edertal nach Fritzlar, Wabern und Felsberg
Um 5.30 Uhr traf die Flutwelle ein

title: Young's loss
basis: The ORB editor's note; the two differ by a minute.

records.says: "Dinghy" Young's Lancaster was shot down by flak North of Ijmuiden at 0258 (Castricum aan Zee) killing all the crew.
records.label: ORB editor's note

title: Townsend's target
basis: Townsend's own report; the dams' coordinates put the Bever 11 km south of the Ennepe, not north-west.

records.says: ENNEPE DAM. 1 Mine. 60ft. 0337 hrs.
Post war research proves that Townsend attacked not the Ennerpe Dam but the Bever Dam nearby to the North West instead.
records.label: ORB editor's note

records.says: Sweetman (2002) makes a strong case that the fourth dam attacked was the Bever Dam

title: Martin's mine
basis: The ORB's distance; Wikipedia agrees it missed.

records.says: Mine burst about 20 yds. short.
Mine missed the target.

title: The Sorpe run
reading: Along the crest, unspun; McCarthy in over Langscheid's steeple
basis: McCarthy's own report of "the run along the Dam" (ORB). His crew came in over the church of St. Antonius, Langscheid, 320 m to the lake side of the crest line, at some 30-40° to the crest, as the editor's note has it, and turned onto it before the dam.

records.says: the approach was made along the length of the dam, not at right angles over the reservoir
detailed to fly from left to right at about 30 degrees with the mine bouncing up to the dam face
records.label: ORB editor's note

records.says: led over a church steeple in the village of Langscheid
The approach involved flying over the small town of Langscheid, which had a prominent church steeple

title: Release speed
basis: The operation order's figure.

records.says: the height of attack is to be 60 feet and the ground speed 220 m.p.h.
at an air speed of 240 mph (390 km/h)
we were being dragged along at four miles a minute

title: Möhne flak
reading: Six guns, one battery at the dam
basis: The German record of the defending battery.

records.says: nur noch sechs 2-cm-Flakgeschütze der 3. Batterie leichte Flakabteilung 840, die zur Flakgruppe Dortmund gehörte.
Die Sologeschütze hatten ihre Stellungen am Ende der Sperrmauer, unterhalb der Talsperre und auf den zwei Türmen bezogen.
There were between seven and ten light flak guns around the target

title: Serials of AJ-A and AJ-T
basis: The usual identifications of the aircraft flown; the ORB transcript's serials disagree.

records.says: ED877 was hit by Flak
records.label: Young's loss, whose registration field reads ED887

records.says: Lancaster III ED 923 G. (T)
records.label: McCarthy's sheet

records.says: McCarthy flew the spare ED825/G.
